contentJudgment: The condensation preserves the argument rather than turning finitude into another promise of efficiency. The move from limited life to deliberate omission, attention, uncertain plans, intrinsically valuable leisure, patience, shared time and ordinary significance is intelligible at all three depths. Deep supplies actual cases and the ten genuine appendix practices. No required meaning correction found.

Read the ten proposals continuously. Verified ten-item closed list, fixed hours as an addition, serial major projects with everyday duties retained, strategic failure, done list, bounded causes, boring devices, ordinary novelty, curiosity, immediate generosity and five/ten-minute doing-nothing exercise.

optionalSuggestions.ru: Важное не просто получает меньше времени: оно систематически не начинается.
optionalSuggestions.en: Important work receives more than insufficient time: it systematically fails to start.
optionalSuggestions.suggestion: A more natural English sentence would be: “Important work does not merely get too little time; it repeatedly fails to get started.” The existing continuation already makes the intended meaning clear.

materialLimitations: Primary reading was targeted to delivered arguments and cases, with the appendix read continuously. I did not read every chapter continuously or certify all historical/philosophical sources and psychological effects.
